utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Hey Kira! Did you hear about the community repair drive this Saturday? They're fixing up old appliances for free!

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Wait, for real? Is that actually happening? I haven't seen any flyers.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh yeah, I saw it on the neighborhood Facebook group! I think the church on Elm Street is hosting it.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Hey Noah, did you hear about the repair drive this weekend?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Huh? Oh, the repair drive? I think I saw a flyer but I forgot the details.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: It's this Saturday from 10 AM to 4 PM at the community center. They're fixing small appliances and electronics for free.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Ira, need help with the repair drive tomorrow?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Repair drive? I haven't heard about that. What's happening?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Some of us are fixing broken appliances on the street. 9 AM at the corner.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Hey Cleo, I heard you've been working on the repair drive. How's that going?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: It's coming along, Rey. I've been sorting through the donated tools and organizing them by task.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: That sounds like a lot of work. Need any help sorting?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Hi Jules, are you planning to join the repair drive this weekend?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Absolutely, I'll be there! Do you know what time everyone's meeting up?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Great! We're planning to start at 9 AM on Saturday. Does that work for you?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: So, Oren, what's the schedule for the repair drive? I like to have things planned out.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, the schedule! I had it written down somewhere... let me think. Maybe it's on that flyer I left on the porch?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Let me check the porch, I might have seen that flyer.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Hey Pia, have you heard about the neighborhood repair drive this weekend? We could really use your help!

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Oh, a repair drive? I'm a bit worried about the timing—do we have enough supplies and volunteers?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Don't worry, we've got plenty of supplies! And I'm already rallying folks—your help would be awesome!

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Hey Rosa, I heard there's a repair drive happening. What's that all about?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Oh, it's a community event where we fix broken items together—like electronics, furniture, or clothes—instead of throwing them away. It's fun and helps reduce waste!

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: That sounds awesome! How do I get involved? Is there a sign-up or something?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: What's the repair drive about? I want to make sure I understand the plan before we proceed.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: The repair drive is where we all bring broken items from home, and we fix them together with donated tools and materials. It's a great way to reduce waste and help each other out.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: So everyone brings their own broken items, and we share tools? Do we need to sign up in advance?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: The repair drive, huh? I could use some help with my porch steps.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Hey Uli, I can definitely give you a hand with those steps—just let me know when you want to start.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Dane. I appreciate it. How about Saturday morning?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Hey Mina, heard you're organizing the repair drive. I've got a bunch of tools I can lend out.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Great, what kind of tools do you have?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: I've got hammers, screwdrivers, wrenches, a power drill—pretty much the basics for any home repair.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Bo, where exactly is that repair drive supposed to happen?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Oh, it's over by the community center, I think.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: The community center? Which side of the building — the parking lot or the green space?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Hey Rey, I heard you're working on a repair drive. Need me to lend you some tools?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Gus. That would help a lot.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure, just let me know what you need, and I'll grab 'em from my shed.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Did we remember to arrange a tow truck if the repair drive fails?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Wait, why would we need a tow truck? Is the repair drive actually going to work?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I'm just thinking ahead—if it doesn't work, we'll be stuck without a plan.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Hey Mara, I heard you're helping organize the repair drive. How's that going?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: It's going well, thanks for asking! We've got a good turnout of volunteers so far.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: That's great to hear! Is there anything specific you need help with or any way I can pitch in?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Hey Dane, what supplies do we need for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sorry, I just got here. What did I miss?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: We're planning a repair drive for the neighborhood, and I'm trying to figure out what supplies we need. Do you have any idea?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Hey Faye, have you heard about the repair drive happening this weekend?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Oh, yes, I saw a flyer. But this weekend is packed with school stuff—is it happening all day?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: I think it's from 9 to 3, so you could pop by in the morning or after school.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Hey Rosa, just caught me on the run. What's this about a repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Oh, Bo! Yes, we're organizing a community repair drive this Saturday to fix up the neighborhood playground. Can I count on your help?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Yeah, sure, sounds good. I'm in.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Hey Leo, I heard you're organizing a repair drive. Need a hand with anything?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Sure, can you check the tool inventory?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Absolutely, I can do that. Where can I find the inventory list?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Hey Nell, have you heard about the repair drive this weekend? I'm helping round up volunteers, you in?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: What repair drive? I must've missed the memo—what's it about?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: It's a neighborhood event where we fix up broken items—like furniture, appliances, clothes—instead of tossing them. We meet at the community center at 10 AM Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Have you seen the repair drive lately? I think it might be down near the old oak tree.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: No, I haven't seen it. I always take my morning walk by the oak, but I must have missed it.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Hmm, maybe it's further along the path then. I'll check near the creek after lunch.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: So, what's this repair drive all about?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I'm not sure yet—can you tell me more about what needs fixing?

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Well, the community center's door is broken, and the playground swing needs mending.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Hey Oren, I heard you were organizing a repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, a repair drive? I think I remember something about that... or maybe I'm confusing it with the bake sale last week?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Yeah, I think it was supposed to be this weekend at the community center. Did you see the flyer?
